what: DraftKings runs online sports betting and casino games in the United States and Canada, plus daily fantasy sports, in every state that has legalised them.
customers: American sports bettors and online casino players, in roughly 25 states.
money: a large and more profitable part
moat: One of the two brands American bettors know, with the marketing budget and product development to stay there as each new state legalises.
risks: A $379M net loss: customer acquisition and promotions still consume the gross profit
Several states have raised betting tax rates after legalising, which cuts the margin retroactively
Prediction markets offering sports contracts are an emerging competitor with lighter regulation
opportunities: $324M of free cash flow, the first meaningful positive cash generation
Revenue grew from $1.3B to $6.1B in four years
Analysts see about 57% upside, with 36 covering, and large states including Texas and California have not legalised yet
watch: Monthly unique payers and the structural hold percentage in mature states.
